ائتوين (form VIII)
# اِئْتَوَيْنَ (iʔtawayna) /iʔ.ta.waj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# اِئْتَوِينَ (iʔtawīna) /iʔ.ta.wiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
